Compute, Check and Confirm a Payslip

User manual · English · 11 steps
Learn how to open an employee's payslip, check the worked days it is based on, recompute it, read the salary computation line by line, and confirm it.

1. Open Payroll

Open the Payroll app.

2. Payslips menu

Open the Payslips menu.

3. All Payslips

Click All Payslips.

4. Open a batch

Click a batch name to show its payslips.

5. Open a payslip

Click a payslip to open it.

6. Worked days and inputs

Click the Worked Days & Inputs tab.

7. Compute Sheet

Click Compute Sheet to recalculate the payslip.

8. Salary Computation tab

Click the Salary Computation tab.

9. Read the lines

Look at the Total column, then click it to continue.

10. Confirm the payslip

Click Create Draft Entry to confirm the payslip.

11. Confirm in the window

Click Ok to confirm.
